title: Regularization of a Divergent Arithmetic Product via the Asymptotic Monoid: The Case of $(-1)^{ω(n)}$
summary: We apply the generalized monoid of words and logarithmic-prefix functionals of \cite{C1} to the regularization of the divergent product \[ P_ω=\prod_{n=1}^{\infty} n^{(-1)^{ω(n)}}, \] where \(ω(n)\) is the number of distinct prime divisors of \(n\). The associated Dirichlet series \(D_ω(s)=\sum_{n\ge1}(-1)^{ω(n)}n^{-s}\) has a natural boundary at \(\Re(s)=0\), as established by Meretov (1987) and recovered here as a special case of the Estermann--Dahlquist theory of Euler products, which makes zeta regularization impossible: the derivative \(D_ω'(0)\) does not exist.
